#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Witness {
    pub node: usize,
    pub truth: Truth,
    pub negated: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct NodeTrace {
    pub node: usize,
    pub parent: Option<usize>,
    pub kind: NodeKind,
    pub truth: Truth,
    pub skip: Option<Skip<usize>>,
    pub witnesses: Vec<Witness>,
    pub default_witnesses: Vec<Witness>,
}
